sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_customer FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY wilayah

question: Weighted pipeline per wilayah sales, urut terbesar.
sql: SELECT r.region, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY weighted_pipeline DESC

question: Produk apa saja yang omset tahun ininya lebih dari 50.000.000? Tampilkan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT produk, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY produk HAVING total_omset > 50000000

question: Untuk deal yang masih berjalan, hitung per produk: jumlah deal, customer unik, dan total nilainya.
sql: SELECT produk, count() AS jumlah_deal, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_customer, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY produk

question: Cari customer yang punya lebih dari 3 tiket dan rata-rata waktu penyelesaiannya di atas 100 jam.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tiket > 3 AND rata_rata_jam > 100

question: sales mana yg 90 hari terakhir punya lebih dari 90 aktivitas dan rata2 durasinya di atas 60 menit?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_aktivitas > 90 AND rata_rata_durasi > 60

question: Per tipe dan sentimen aktivitas, tampilkan jumlah, rata-rata durasi, dan persentil 90 durasi; urutkan per tipe lalu jumlah terbanyak.
sql: SELECT a.type, a.sentiment, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, quantile(0.9)(a.duration_minutes) AS p90_durasi FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type, a.sentiment ORDER BY a.type, jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Tag apa saja yang dimiliki lebih dari 200 pelanggan aktif?
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY tag HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 200

question: Per wilayah pelanggan dan tier, hitung jumlah customer serta berapa industri berbeda di dalamnya.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, count() AS jumlah_customer, uniqExact(c.attributes['industry']) AS jumlah_industri FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY wilayah, tier

question: Ringkasan pipeline per stage: jumlah deal, total nilai, weighted pipeline, dan rata-rata probabilitas.
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS weighted_pipeline, round(avg(d.probability), 2) AS rata_rata_probabilitas FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.stage

question: Untuk tiket 180 hari terakhir, tampilkan median, persentil 95, dan maksimum waktu penyelesaian per prioritas.
sql: SELECT t.priority, median(t.resolution_time_hours) AS median_jam, quantile(0.95)(t.resolution_time_hours) AS p95_jam, max(t.resolution_time_hours) AS max_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 180) GROUP BY t.priority

question: 5 customer dengan omset terbesar tahun ini, tapi hanya yang punya minimal 2 deal won tahun ini.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, count() AS jumlah_deal_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_deal_won >= 2 ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: Siapa 10 sales dengan aktivitas terbanyak bulan ini? Tampilkan nama dan jumlahnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC LIMIT 10

question: rata2 nilai deal per segmen customer & stage
sql: SELECT c.segment, d.stage, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, d.stage

question: Hitung tiket terbuka per segmen pelanggan, urut terbanyak.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_tiket_terbuka DESC

question: Industri mana yang rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiketnya lebih dari 100 jam?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY industri HAVING rata_rata_jam > 100

question: Per wilayah sales: berapa sales berbeda yang closing won tahun ini dan total omsetnya?
sql: SELECT r.region, uniqExact(d.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region

question: Untuk deal won, tampilkan per produk rata-rata dan median nilai deal, khusus produk yang punya lebih dari 500 deal won.
sql: SELECT produk, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai, median(d.value) AS median_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY produk HAVING count() > 500

question: Kelompokkan pelanggan aktif berdasarkan jumlah tag, tampilkan hanya kelompok yang isinya lebih dari 50 pelanggan.
sql: SELECT length(c.tags) AS jumlah_tag, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY jumlah_tag HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 50

question: top 10 sales berdasarkan total durasi meeting 30 hari terakhir, sekalian brp customer unik yg mereka temui
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_customer FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_durasi DESC LIMIT 10

question: Customer mana saja yang tahun ini punya lebih dari 3 aktivitas bersentimen negatif?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_negatif > 3

question: Per status pelanggan, tampilkan jumlah pelanggan, rata-rata jumlah tag, dan jumlah wilayah pelanggan yang berbeda.
sql: SELECT c.status, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, round(avg(length(c.tags)), 2) AS rata_rata_jumlah_tag, uniqExact(c.attributes['region']) AS jumlah_wilayah FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.status

question: Per tim sales: jumlah anggota dan berapa region berbeda yang mereka cover.
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_sales, uniqExact(r.region) AS jumlah_region FROM sales_reps AS r GROUP BY r.team

question: 3 produk dengan forecast terbesar?
sql: SELECT produk, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY produk ORDER BY forecast DESC LIMIT 3

question: Tampilkan kuartil 25, 50, dan 75 nilai deal per stage dalam satu kolom array.
sql: SELECT d.stage, quantiles(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)(d.value) AS kuartil_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.stage

question: Customer dengan total nilai pipeline di atas 500.000 dan lebih dari 2 deal berjalan?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_deal > 2 AND total_pipeline > 500000

question: Sales yang rata-rata probabilitas deal berjalannya di atas 50 dan total pipeline-nya lebih dari 8.000.000.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(d.probability), 2) AS rata_rata_probabilitas, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING rata_rata_probabilitas > 50 AND total_pipeline > 8000000

question: Omset bulan lalu per tim dan wilayah sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.region, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.region

question: Tahun ini, berapa jumlah deal won dan omset untuk tiap tier pelanggan?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, count() AS jumlah_deal_won, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY tier

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, hitung jumlah tiket urgent dan rata-rata waktu penyelesaiannya.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_tiket_urgent, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY wilayah

question: Segmen mana yang punya lebih dari 30 pelanggan baru bertag tech tahun ini?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'tech') AND c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 30

question: Untuk deal yang dibuat 90 hari terakhir, tampilkan per stage jumlah, total, rata-rata, dan nilai maksimum; urut total terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai, max(d.value) AS nilai_tertinggi FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY total_nilai DESC

question: Industri yang customer churn-nya lebih dari 80, urutkan dari yang terbanyak.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY industri HAVING jumlah_churn > 80 ORDER BY jumlah_churn DESC

question: Siapa 5 sales dengan deal lost terbanyak kuartal ini? Tampilkan nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_deal_lost DESC LIMIT 5

question: list customer yg total durasi aktivitasnya lebih dari 1000 menit dan aktivitasnya lebih dari 15 kali
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_aktivitas > 15 AND total_durasi > 1000

question: Untuk tiket berprioritas high dan urgent, tampilkan per status dan prioritas jumlah tiket serta customer unik.
sql: SELECT t.status, t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_customer FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent') GROUP BY t.status, t.priority

question: Per produk, berapa jumlah dan total nilai deal pipeline yang probabilitasnya minimal 60?
sql: SELECT produk, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.probability >= 60 GROUP BY produk

question: Segmen pelanggan mana yang rata-rata nilai deal won-nya di atas 250rb?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment HAVING rata_rata_nilai > 250000

question: Per wilayah sales, hitung jumlah aktivitas dan total durasinya untuk aktivitas tipe support_ticket.
sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'support_ticket' GROUP BY r.region

question: Customer mana yang sudah pernah mengalami kelima tipe aktivitas?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(a.type) AS jumlah_tipe FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tipe = 5

question: Bandingkan rata-rata dan median durasi aktivitas antar tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, median(a.duration_minutes) AS median_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team

question: Rata-rata durasi aktivitas per sales, khusus sales yang punya minimal 750 aktivitas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING count() >= 750
